as_read: Mixed: pooled tea and extract trials favor hibiscus on blood pressure with high heterogeneity, while the extract capsule evidence is a Cochrane single trial judged insufficient and a null 1000 mg/day RCT.

stop_list: 34837382 states a total dose of 5600 mg, not per day; no value recorded, so that context stays without a verified dose. 34837382 includes one trial, so it is a review of a single trial rather than a pool.
Two cranberry labels: 74364 prints no hibiscus amount, 74399 prints 100 mg; both are combinations.
clinician_items: 23333908: review notes possible adverse hepatic effects at high doses and evidence of a diuretic action.
39870328: minor, clinically insignificant AST increase; authors say long-term and therapeutic dosing safety needs careful monitoring.

38952776 and 42011348: extract used with valsartan; blood pressure lowering alongside antihypertensive drugs, with 42011348 reporting greater kidney and lipid effects and lesser blood pressure and glucose effects than the hydrochlorothiazide control. Worth a look at the interaction lane.
